## What changes and why / 改了什么、解决什么问题

## Validation / 验证

Commands run, results and any checks not performed:

For motion changes, attach simulator settings and a relevant recording/log.
运动行为修改请附模拟器设置及对应录像或日志。

## Documentation and third-party material / 文档与第三方内容

Note public-interface changes, README language updates, and provenance/license of new assets.
说明公开接口变化、中英文文档更新，以及新增素材的来源和许可。
